MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 90
   C. 42
   D. 30

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 34

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 11
   C. 7
   D. 5

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

17. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 6

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

25. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

26. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

27. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

28. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

29. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

30. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42
